evidence: ZnS was deposited using DEZn (Morton, electronic grade) and H2S (Messer, 99.8%) as precursors. The H2S flow was set to 5–5.5sccm (continuous flow). For Mn doping, a Mn(thd)3-containing crucible was heated in situ at around 1351C. The growth rate was determined from the thickness near the trailing edge of the substrate, with respect to the precursor flow direction. The purge times are distinguished by triangles (0.7s purge times), squares (0.5s purge times) or by circles (0.3s purge times).
